site.title: Aakash Kumar | Enterprise Automation & DevSecOps
site.description: Public portfolio for a lead platform and DevSecOps engineer focused on vulnerability governance, remediation orchestration, and AI-ready workflow automation.
site.overview_intro: This upgraded portfolio is designed to present product ownership, enterprise workflow design, and credible operational scale. The content stays public and non-confidential while still showing architecture, governance, and delivery depth.
identity_points: Lead and product owner mindset across roadmap, experience design, and workflow decisions.
Public-facing narrative centered on secure automation, remediation planning, and operational visibility.
JSON-driven content model so updates happen in data, not brittle string replacements.
site.current_focus_title: Workflow intelligence for secure enterprise operations
site.current_focus_body: Core emphasis is on owner-led remediation planning, host tagging, dashboard visibility, lower-environment-first patch sequencing, and coordinated execution across Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, Jenkins, and Ansible Automation Platform. The roadmap direction includes agentic remediation and AI-assisted root cause analysis for workflow failures.
site.section_narrative: The upgraded information architecture separates presentation from content, introduces an accessible tabs model, and adds a lightweight 3D globe hero that communicates platform-scale systems thinking. It also keeps the public narrative accurate: product ownership, remediation orchestration, release-safe sequencing, and automation-led governance.
site.footer_note: Built with Streamlit, Jinja2, and Three.js using a JSON-driven content layer.
